title: Models a Finance Ministry Can Audit

slides.title: Models a Finance Ministry Can Audit
slides.subtitle: The Climate Policy Assessment Tool, rebuilt and validated: section 5 in ten slides
slides.message: A model a ministry can use must be small enough to state on a few pages, built at least twice, and tested against data and other models. CPAT now is: fourteen equations, two rebuilds, a public register of its errors, and a check of its elasticities.
slides.author: Stephen J. Stretton · writing in a personal capacity
